purpose: Define which MathBridge outputs are safe to assemble now and which still require more evidence.

ready_now.scope: All 121 concepts have a joined intelligence profile.
Use Grades 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6 learning stages and section locators. Do not convert these into exact current PEP grade placements.
Use verified National Curriculum in England year-by-year records.
Use verified Common Core grade records and standard codes where available; identify it as a baseline.
Present a representation as system-specific only when guidance/textbook evidence supports that claim; otherwise present it as a teaching option.
All 121 concepts have at least one diagnostic route. A response is a signal to probe, not a diagnosis.
Canonical terminology and interface labels are defined; classroom testing of wording is still useful.
China section locators, England year/strand resolution and Common Core standard-code resolution are available.

not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.capability: Exact current PEP Grade 1-6 semester/unit sequence
not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.reason: Only Grade 1 upper has partial current 12th-series unit evidence; remaining volumes are not directly verified.

not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.capability: Exact page numbers for the China 2022 PDF
not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.reason: The official PDF could not be rendered in the current tool path because of file size. Section locators are available; printed page remains null.

not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.capability: Claim that a representation is routinely used across China, England or the US
not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.reason: Curriculum and guidance sources do not establish national classroom frequency.

not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.capability: Empirical prevalence of every listed misconception
not_ready_as_unqualified_claims.reason: Many diagnostic misconception records are curriculum_inferred. They are suitable as possible reasoning patterns to probe, not prevalence claims.
Curricula sequence concepts differently. Comparisons must resolve concept-specific progression rather than match grade numbers.

national_stage_mode.description: Teacher selects a Chinese grade; if exact current textbook evidence is unavailable, MathBridge resolves the relevant national learning stage and labels it clearly.

exact_current_pep_mode.description: Requires direct verification of current 12th-series volumes before claiming exact grade/semester/unit placement.

highest_priority_gap: Current PEP 12th-series Grade 1-6 volume sequencing and teacher-guide evidence.
workaround: Do not block the product on unavailable volume data. Use verified national-stage comparisons now and overlay exact PEP sequencing when direct evidence becomes available.
